tools.name: create_signup_sheet
tools.description: Creates a live online sign-up sheet on SignUpSheet.page where people claim slots from one shared link without an account, and returns the share link and the private organizer link. Use it when the user wants people to sign up for things: dishes for a potluck or class party, volunteer shifts, snack o

tools.name: create_date_poll
tools.description: Creates a group scheduling poll on SignUpSheet.page: people open one link and answer yes, maybe or no for each date or time option, and the option that works for most people is highlighted. Returns the share link and the private organizer link, where the organizer can pick the final time and notify

tools.name: create_group_card
tools.description: Creates an online group card on SignUpSheet.page for one person: everyone opens one shared link and writes a message, and the organizer delivers the finished card later by email, on screen or printed. Use it for a farewell, birthday, retirement, thank-you, new baby, get well, sympathy, welcome, wedd

tools.name: get_sheet_summary
tools.description: Reads the current public status of a SignUpSheet.page sign-up sheet, date poll or group card from its share link: which slots are open or full, poll answers per option, or how many people have signed a card. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_signup_sheet, create_date_poll, create_group_card, get_sheet_summary · Private data: create_signup_sheet, create_date_poll, create_group_card, get_sheet_summary · Public sink: create_signup_sheet, create_date_poll, create_group_card, get_sheet_summary.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_signup_sheet, create_date_poll, create_group_card, get_sheet_summary · Private data: create_signup_sheet, create_date_poll, create_group_card, get_sheet_summary · Public sink: create_signup_sheet, create_date_poll, create_group_card, get_sheet_summary

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
